#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Cli { command: Option<Commands> }
#[derive(clap::Subcommand)]
pub enum Commands { Named { arg: Arg }, Tuple(Arg), Unit }
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Arg;
impl Cli {
    pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        match self.command { Some(command) => command.act(), None => Ok(()) }
    }
}
impl Commands {
    pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        match self {
            Self::Named { arg } => arg.act(),
            Self::Tuple(ref arg) => Arg::act(arg),
            Self::Unit => Ok(()),
        }
    }
}
impl Arg { pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> { Ok(()) } }
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Conditional { command: Option<Commands> }
impl Conditional {
    pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        if let Some(command) = self.command { command.act()?; }
        Ok(())
    }
}
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Repeated { command: Option<Commands> }
impl Repeated {
    pub fn act(mut self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        while let Some(command) = self.command { command.act()?; }
        Ok(())
    }
}
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Bound { command: Commands }
impl Bound {
    pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        let Self { command } = self;
        command.act()
    }
}
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Forwarded { command: Commands }
impl Forwarded {
    pub fn act(self) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
        (&self.command).clone().act()
    }
}
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Missing;
pub fn dispatch(cli: Missing) {}
#[cfg(any())]
#[derive(clap::Parser)]
pub struct Inactive;
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests { #[derive(clap::Parser)] pub struct Ignored; }
mod external;
mod inline { pub mod nested; }
#[path = "../support.rs"]
mod support;
fn local_scope() {
    #[path = "../function_local.rs"] mod local;
}
